#!/bin/sh
# managed by machine install idle-suspend, version 8
# Suspends this box once it has been idle for MINUTES minutes. Run as root by machine-idle-suspend.timer every 30 s, 1 min or 2 min (the smallest of the three minutes below decides, decision 113).
# Generated by "machine install idle-suspend --minutes <n>": do not edit (the next install rewrites it). See idle-suspend.md.
# EVERY input that cannot be read means "not idle": this script never suspends on an error.
ROOT=''
MINUTES=30
RDP_MINUTES=20
SSH_MINUTES=20
WAKE_GRACE_MINUTES=5
GAP_SECONDS=600
DATE='/usr/bin/date'
SS='/usr/bin/ss'
INHIBIT='/usr/bin/systemd-inhibit'
LOGGER='/usr/bin/logger'
SYSTEMCTL='/usr/bin/systemctl'
LOGINCTL='/usr/bin/loginctl'
RUNUSER='/usr/sbin/runuser'
XPRINTIDLE='/usr/bin/xprintidle'
AUDIT_LOG='/home/alice/.config/machine/audit.log'
PORT_FILE='/home/alice/.config/machine/daemon.port.json'
KEEP_AWAKE_USER='/home/alice/.config/machine/keep-awake'
KEEP_AWAKE_RUN='/run/machine-keep-awake'
STATE_DIR='/run/machine-idle-suspend'
STATE_FILE='/run/machine-idle-suspend/since'
RESUME_FILE='/run/machine-idle-suspend/resume'
RESUME_COUNTER='/sys/power/suspend_stats/success'

# resume_note ends every line of the pass once the resume detection is off (decision 113): the cause is never silent.
resume_note=''
log() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1$resume_note"
  "$ROOT$LOGGER" -t machine-idle-suspend -- "$1$resume_note" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
clear_state() { rm -f -- "$ROOT$STATE_FILE"; }
not_idle() { clear_state; log "not idle: $1"; exit 0; }

now=$("$ROOT$DATE" +%s 2>/dev/null)
case $now in ''|*[!0-9]*) log "cannot read the clock (date failed): not suspending"; exit 1 ;; esac

# (r) Decision 113: resume detection, at EVERY pass before any check. The kernel counter of the successful suspends is compared with the record of the previous pass
# (<counter> <epoch it was first seen>, or "unreadable <epoch>"). A greater, lower or unrecorded counter is a resume NOW: the wake grace starts at this pass (at most one cadence
# after the real wake). An unreadable counter is a resume ONCE: the record "unreadable" keeps the start of that grace, so it never blocks for ever, and the cause ends every line.
resume_cause=''
resume_counter=$(cat -- "$ROOT$RESUME_COUNTER" 2>/dev/null) || resume_cause="cannot read /sys/power/suspend_stats/success (missing or unreadable)"
if [ -z "$resume_cause" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$resume_counter" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})$' || resume_cause="/sys/power/suspend_stats/success does not hold a whole number"
fi
stored_kind=absent
stored_counter=''
stored_seen=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE" ]; then
  stored_kind=bad
  if stored_text=$(cat -- "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE" 2>/dev/null); then
    if printf '%s\n' "$stored_text" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,12} [0-9]{1,12}$'; then
      read -r stored_counter stored_seen <<EOF
$stored_text
EOF
      stored_kind=counter
    elif printf '%s\n' "$stored_text" | grep -Eq '^unreadable [0-9]{1,12}$'; then
      read -r stored_word stored_seen <<EOF
$stored_text
EOF
      stored_kind=unreadable
    fi
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$resume_cause" ]; then
  resume_note=" (resume detection off: $resume_cause)"
  if [ "$stored_kind" = unreadable ]; then resume_seen=$stored_seen; else resume_seen=$now; fi
  resume_record=unreadable
else
  case $stored_kind in
    counter) if [ "$resume_counter" -eq "$stored_counter" ]; then resume_seen=$stored_seen; else resume_seen=$now; fi ;;
    unreadable) resume_seen=$stored_seen ;;
    *) resume_seen=$now ;;
  esac
  resume_record=$resume_counter
fi
if [ "$resume_seen" -gt "$now" ]; then resume_seen=$now; fi
mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot create $STATE_DIR: not suspending"; exit 1; }
{ printf '%s %s\n' "$resume_record" "$resume_seen" > "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE"; } 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot write $RESUME_FILE: not suspending"; exit 1; }
grace_left=$((resume_seen + WAKE_GRACE_MINUTES * 60 - now))

# (a) keep-awake files: any content keeps the box awake; "until <epoch>" (or "keep awake until <epoch>") only until then.
check_keep_awake() {
  [ -e "$ROOT$1" ] || return 0
  content=$(cat -- "$ROOT$1" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the keep-awake files"
  until_epoch=$(printf '%s\n' "$content" | sed -n -E '1{s/^[[:space:]]+//;s/[[:space:]]+$//;s/^(keep awake )?until ([0-9]{1,12})$/\2/p;}')
  if [ -n "$until_epoch" ] && [ "$until_epoch" -le "$now" ]; then return 0; fi
  not_idle "keep-awake requested"
}
check_keep_awake "$KEEP_AWAKE_RUN"
check_keep_awake "$KEEP_AWAKE_USER"

# (b) established connections to RDP, ssh and the machine peer port (read from the daemon port file).
peer_port=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$PORT_FILE" ]; then
  port_json=$(cat -- "$ROOT$PORT_FILE" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
  peer_port=$(printf '%s\n' "$port_json" | sed -n -E 's/.*"peerPort"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*([0-9]{1,5}).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$peer_port" ] || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
fi
sockets=$("$ROOT$SS" -Htn state established 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
rdp=0
ssh=0
peer=0
while read -r c1 c2 c3 c4 rest; do
  case $c1 in ESTAB|estab) local_addr=$c4 ;; *) local_addr=$c3 ;; esac
  port=$(printf '%s\n' "$local_addr" | sed 's/.*://')
  [ "$port" = 3389 ] && rdp=$((rdp + 1))
  [ "$port" = 22 ] && ssh=$((ssh + 1))
  if [ -n "$peer_port" ] && [ "$port" = "$peer_port" ]; then peer=$((peer + 1)); fi
done <<EOF
$sockets
EOF
# (b1) Decision 111: EVERY ssh connection is tested. It is read here, before any later check can exit, so the samples of the notty connections are kept at every run
# (they are NOT cleared with the timer state). ss -Htinp prints, per connection, a line with the Process column (every pid of the login: the [priv] parent AND the
# user process) and, tab-indented, the counters. The title of each pid (/proc/<pid>/cmdline, set by sshd) ending in @pts/<n> is a terminal login: activity while the input
# idle time of its tty (atime of /dev/pts/<n>, what w and logind read) is below SSH_MINUTES, its traffic is ignored. A title ending in @notty (scp, rsync, ssh host cmd,
# herdr) is activity when the average rate of its TCP connection since the previous run (bytes_acked + bytes_received, samples file) is at least THRESHOLD B/s, or unknown
# (first sight, sample older than 5 min, counter went down, counters unreadable). Anything unreadable (no login title for the connection, a tty that is not pts/<n>,
# no stat, an atime in the future, no ss, no samples file to write) is activity, with the cause. /dev/pts is never listed (a stale pts has no sshd process).
THRESHOLD=2048
SSH_SAMPLES='/run/machine-idle-suspend/ssh-samples'
ssh_fail=''
ssh_pts_secs=''
ssh_pts_tty=''
ssh_block=''
ssh_quiet_note=''
ssh_new_samples=''
ssh_old=''
ssh_cur_open=0
ssh_cur_local=''
ssh_cur_peer=''
ssh_cur_proc=''
ssh_cur_info=''
ssh_fail_set() { [ -n "$ssh_fail" ] || ssh_fail="$1"; }
ssh_unknown() { [ -n "$ssh_block" ] || ssh_block="ssh connection $c_peer rate unknown ($1)"; }
ssh_notty() {
  c_acked=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_info" | grep -Eo '(^|[[:space:]])bytes_acked:[^[:space:]]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*://')
  c_recv=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_info" | grep -Eo '(^|[[:space:]])bytes_received:[^[:space:]]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*://')
  printf '%s\n' "$c_acked" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "bytes_acked or bytes_received missing or not a number in ss -tin"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$c_recv" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "bytes_acked or bytes_received missing or not a number in ss -tin"; return 0; }
  c_total=$((c_acked + c_recv))
  ssh_new_samples="$ssh_new_samples$c_local $c_peer $now $c_total
"
  prev_epoch=''
  prev_total=''
  while read -r o_local o_peer o_epoch o_total o_rest; do
    if [ "$o_local" = "$c_local" ] && [ "$o_peer" = "$c_peer" ]; then prev_epoch=$o_epoch; prev_total=$o_total; break; fi
  done <<EOF
$ssh_old
EOF
  [ -n "$prev_epoch" ] || { ssh_unknown "first check of this connection (no previous sample)"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$prev_epoch" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})$' && printf '%s\n' "$prev_total" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "previous sample unreadable"; return 0; }
  c_dt=$((now - prev_epoch))
  [ "$c_dt" -gt 0 ] || { ssh_unknown "the clock did not advance since the previous sample"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_dt" -le 300 ] || { ssh_unknown "previous sample older than 300 s"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_total" -ge "$prev_total" ] || { ssh_unknown "byte counter went down (a new connection on the same address)"; return 0; }
  c_rate=$(( (c_total - prev_total) / c_dt ))
  if [ "$c_rate" -ge "$THRESHOLD" ]; then
    [ -n "$ssh_block" ] || ssh_block="ssh connection $c_peer active ($c_rate B/s, needs $THRESHOLD)"
  else
    ssh_quiet_note="$ssh_quiet_note (ssh connection $c_peer quiet: $c_rate B/s, under $THRESHOLD)"
  fi
}
ssh_conn() {
  c_local=$1
  c_peer=$2
  c_proc=$3
  c_info=$4
  c_kind=''
  c_login_pid=''
  for c_pid in $(printf '%s\n' "$c_proc" | grep -Eo 'pid=[0-9]{1,8}' | sed 's/^pid=//'); do
    c_file="$ROOT/proc/$c_pid/cmdline"
    [ -e "$c_file" ] || continue
    c_title=$(tr -d '\000' <"$c_file" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    c_tty=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_title" | sed -n -E 's/^sshd(-session)?: [^ ]+@(.*)$/\2/p')
    [ -n "$c_tty" ] || continue
    c_kind=$c_tty
    c_login_pid=$c_pid
    break
  done
  if [ -z "$c_kind" ]; then ssh_fail_set "no sshd login process (title sshd-session: <user>@<tty>) found for the ssh connection $c_peer"; return 0; fi
  if [ "$c_kind" = notty ]; then ssh_notty; return 0; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$c_kind" | grep -Eq '^pts/[0-9]{1,6}$' || { ssh_fail_set "an sshd login process has an unexpected tty in its title ($c_login_pid)"; return 0; }
  c_atime=$(stat -c %X -- "$ROOT/dev/$c_kind" 2>/dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot read the idle time of $c_kind (stat /dev/$c_kind failed)"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$c_atime" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,12}$' || { ssh_fail_set "stat printed no number for /dev/$c_kind"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_atime" -le "$now" ] || { ssh_fail_set "the last input of $c_kind is in the future (clock or tty error)"; return 0; }
  c_secs=$((now - c_atime))
  if [ -z "$ssh_pts_tty" ] || [ "$c_secs" -lt "$ssh_pts_secs" ]; then ssh_pts_secs=$c_secs; ssh_pts_tty=$c_kind; fi
}
ssh_flush() {
  [ "$ssh_cur_open" -eq 1 ] || return 0
  ssh_cur_open=0
  printf '%s\n' "$ssh_cur_local" | grep -Eqx '[][0-9A-Za-z:.%_-]+' && printf '%s\n' "$ssh_cur_peer" | grep -Eqx '[][0-9A-Za-z:.%_-]+' || { ssh_fail_set "cannot parse an address of the ssh connections printed by ss"; return 0; }
  ssh_conn "$ssh_cur_local" "$ssh_cur_peer" "$ssh_cur_proc" "$ssh_cur_info"
}
read_ssh() {
  ssh_listing=$("$ROOT$SS" -Htinp state established '( sport = :22 )' 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot list the ssh connections ($SS -tinp failed)"; return 0; }
  if [ -e "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES" ]; then ssh_old=$(cat -- "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES" 2>/dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot read $SSH_SAMPLES"; ssh_old=''; }; fi
  while IFS= read -r ssh_line; do
    ssh_trim=$(printf '%s\n' "$ssh_line" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
    case $ssh_trim in
      '') continue ;;
      ESTAB*|estab*|[0-9]*) ;;
      *) ssh_cur_info="$ssh_cur_info $ssh_trim"; continue ;;
    esac
    ssh_flush
    read -r c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 <<EOT
$ssh_trim
EOT
    case $c1 in ESTAB|estab) ssh_cur_local=$c4; ssh_cur_peer=$c5; ssh_cur_proc=$c6 ;; *) ssh_cur_local=$c3; ssh_cur_peer=$c4; ssh_cur_proc=$c5 ;; esac
    ssh_cur_info=''
    ssh_cur_open=1
  done <<EOF
$ssh_listing
EOF
  ssh_flush
  if mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null && { printf '%s' "$ssh_new_samples" > "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES"; } 2>/dev/null; then :; else ssh_fail_set "cannot write $SSH_SAMPLES"; fi
}
# Without an ssh connection the samples are dropped (a vanished connection leaves no entry).
if [ "$ssh" -gt 0 ]; then read_ssh; else rm -f -- "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES"; fi
# (b2) the input idle time (xprintidle, ms), measured per logind SESSION (decision 105): the minimum over the user sessions that have an X display, each read as its user.
# input_kind: num (input_secs), missing (no xprintidle), nosession (no such session), bad (input_cause). ignored_text names the X sockets that no such session uses.
input_kind=num
input_secs=''
input_cause=''
ignored_text=''
input_bad() { input_kind=bad; input_cause="$1"; }
read_input() {
  [ -x "$ROOT$XPRINTIDLE" ] || { input_kind=missing; return 0; }
  [ -x "$ROOT$LOGINCTL" ] || { input_bad "loginctl is not installed ($LOGINCTL)"; return 0; }
  [ -x "$ROOT$RUNUSER" ] || { input_bad "runuser is not installed ($RUNUSER)"; return 0; }
  session_list=$("$ROOT$LOGINCTL" list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "loginctl list-sessions failed"; return 0; }
  min_idle=''
  measured=' '
  while read -r sid rest; do
    [ -n "$sid" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$sid" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}$' || { input_bad "loginctl printed an unexpected session id"; return 0; }
    props=$("$ROOT$LOGINCTL" show-session "$sid" -p Name -p Type -p Display -p Class -p State 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "loginctl show-session $sid failed"; return 0; }
    s_class=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Class=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_state=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^State=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_display=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Display=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_name=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Name=//p' | head -n 1)
    [ "$s_class" = user ] || continue
    case $s_state in active|online) ;; *) continue ;; esac
    [ -n "$s_display" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$s_name" | grep -Eq '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$' || { input_bad "the name of session $sid is not a plain user name"; return 0; }
    printf '%s\n' "$s_display" | grep -Eq '^:[0-9]{1,4}$' || { input_bad "session $sid has an unexpected display"; return 0; }
    num=$(printf '%s\n' "$s_display" | sed 's/^://')
    home=$(sed -n -E 's/^'"$s_name"':[^:]*:[0-9]*:[0-9]*:[^:]*:([^:]*):.*/\1/p' "$ROOT/etc/passwd" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
    printf '%s\n' "$home" | grep -Eq '^(/[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+)+$' || { input_bad "no usable home folder for $s_name in /etc/passwd"; return 0; }
    out=$(DISPLAY=":$num" XAUTHORITY="$home/.Xauthority" "$ROOT$RUNUSER" -u "$s_name" -- "$ROOT$XPRINTIDLE" 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "xprintidle failed on :$num as $s_name"; return 0; }
    printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,15}$' || { input_bad "xprintidle printed no number on :$num"; return 0; }
    secs=$((out / 1000))
    if [ -z "$min_idle" ] || [ "$secs" -lt "$min_idle" ]; then min_idle=$secs; fi
    measured="$measured$num "
  done <<EOF
$session_list
EOF
  [ -n "$min_idle" ] || { input_kind=nosession; return 0; }
  input_secs=$min_idle
  # The X sockets that no measured session uses (the login greeter...) are ignored on purpose, and said.
  ignored_list=''
  ignored_count=0
  for sock in "$ROOT/tmp/.X11-unix"/X*; do
    [ -e "$sock" ] || continue
    num=$(printf '%s\n' "$sock" | sed 's/.*\/X//')
    printf '%s\n' "$num" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,4}$' || continue
    case $measured in *" $num "*) continue ;; esac
    if [ -z "$ignored_list" ]; then ignored_list=":$num"; else ignored_list="$ignored_list, :$num"; fi
    ignored_count=$((ignored_count + 1))
  done
  if [ "$ignored_count" -eq 1 ]; then ignored_text=" (ignored display $ignored_list: no user session)"; fi
  if [ "$ignored_count" -gt 1 ]; then ignored_text=" (ignored displays $ignored_list: no user session)"; fi
}
read_input
# With an RDP connection the input idle time is the clock: activity until it reaches RDP_MINUTES, and no timer on top (decision 103).
rdp_mode=0
if [ "$rdp" -gt 0 ]; then
  rdp_mode=1
  [ "$input_kind" != missing ] || not_idle "rdp connected (xprintidle is not installed: sudo apt install xprintidle)"
  [ "$input_kind" != nosession ] || not_idle "rdp connected but no user session found"
  [ "$input_kind" != bad ] || not_idle "rdp connected (input idle unreadable: $input_cause)"
  if [ "$input_secs" -lt $((RDP_MINUTES * 60)) ]; then not_idle "rdp connected (input $((input_secs / 60)) min ago, needs $RDP_MINUTES)$ignored_text"; fi
fi
# Decision 111 verdict (the connections were read in (b1)): unreadable is activity, then a pts login with recent input, then a notty connection that is busy or whose rate is unknown.
ssh_note=''
if [ "$ssh" -gt 0 ]; then
  [ -z "$ssh_fail" ] || not_idle "ssh connected (cannot read the ssh state: $ssh_fail)"
  if [ -n "$ssh_pts_tty" ]; then
    if [ "$ssh_pts_secs" -lt $((SSH_MINUTES * 60)) ]; then
      not_idle "ssh session $ssh_pts_tty active (input $((ssh_pts_secs / 60)) min ago, needs $SSH_MINUTES)"
    fi
    ssh_note=" (ssh session $ssh_pts_tty idle for $((ssh_pts_secs / 60)) min, needs $SSH_MINUTES)"
  fi
  [ -z "$ssh_block" ] || not_idle "$ssh_block"
  ssh_note="$ssh_note$ssh_quiet_note"
fi
[ "$peer" -eq 0 ] || not_idle "machine peer connected"
# Without an RDP connection: a readable input must be MINUTES old; an unreadable one is said on every timer line.
input_note=''
if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 0 ]; then
  case $input_kind in
    num) if [ "$input_secs" -lt $((MINUTES * 60)) ]; then not_idle "input $((input_secs / 60)) min ago (needs $MINUTES)$ignored_text"; fi ;;
    missing) input_note=' (input idleness not checked: xprintidle is not installed)' ;;
    nosession) input_note=' (input idleness not checked: no user session found)' ;;
    *) input_note=" (input idleness not checked: $input_cause)" ;;
  esac
fi

# (c) the machine audit log: a request accepted, completed or held in the last MINUTES minutes, or a hold still open.
epoch_of() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,9})?Z$' || not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log"
  EPOCH=$("$ROOT$DATE" -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null)
  case $EPOCH in ''|*[!0-9]*) not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log" ;; esac
}
audit_tail=$(tail -n 2000 -- "$ROOT$AUDIT_LOG" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log"
last_ts=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"([^"]*)","event":"(accepted|completed|held)".*$/\1/p' | tail -n 1)
last_activity=''
if [ -n "$last_ts" ]; then
  epoch_of "$last_ts"
  last_activity=$EPOCH
fi
held=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"([^"]*)","event":"held","source":"[^"]*","id":"([^"]+)".*$/\1 \2/p' | tail -n 50)
ended=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"[^"]*","event":"hold-ended","source":"[^"]*","id":"([^"]+)".*$/\1/p')
open_holds=0
if [ -n "$held" ]; then
  while read -r held_ts held_id; do
    epoch_of "$held_ts"
    [ $((now - EPOCH)) -le 7200 ] || continue
    if printf '%s\n' "$ended" | grep -Fxq -- "$held_id"; then continue; fi
    open_holds=$((open_holds + 1))
  done <<EOF
$held
EOF
fi
[ "$open_holds" -eq 0 ] || not_idle "machine request on hold"
if [ -n "$last_activity" ] && [ $((now - last_activity)) -lt $((MINUTES * 60)) ]; then
  not_idle "machine request in the last $MINUTES min"
fi

# (d) the 5-minute load average.
loadavg=$(cat -- "$ROOT/proc/loadavg" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the load average"
read -r l1 l5 l15 rest <<EOF
$loadavg
EOF
printf '%s\n' "$l5" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,5})\.[0-9]{2}$' || not_idle "cannot read the load average"
IFS=. read -r load_int load_frac <<EOF
$l5
EOF
load_frac=$(printf '%s' "$load_frac" | sed 's/^0//')
load=$((load_int * 100 + load_frac))
if [ "$load" -ge 30 ]; then
  not_idle "$(printf 'load %d.%02d (limit 0.30)' $((load / 100)) $((load % 100)))"
fi

# (e) an inhibitor in block mode that covers sleep.
inhibitors=$("$ROOT$INHIBIT" --list --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot list the sleep inhibitors"
blocking=$(printf '%s\n' "$inhibitors" | grep -Ec '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])sleep([^[:alnum:]_-]|$).*[[:space:]]block[[:space:]]*$')
[ "$blocking" = 0 ] || not_idle "sleep inhibitor held (block)"
# Decision 113: no automatic suspend during the wake grace (xprintidle counts the sleep, so every reading says idle right after a wake).
if [ "$grace_left" -gt 0 ]; then not_idle "wake grace ($(( (grace_left + 59) / 60 )) min left)"; fi

# Idle now: the timer. The state file holds "<since> <last check>" in epoch seconds.
mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot create $STATE_DIR: not suspending"; exit 1; }
state=none
state_since=''
state_last=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$STATE_FILE" ]; then
  state=bad

$state_text
EOF

fi
write_state() {

}
rdp_idle_text="rdp connected but no input for $((input_secs / 60)) min (needs $RDP_MINUTES)"
restart() {

  if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 1 ]; then log "idle: $rdp_idle_text, confirming at the next check$1$ignored_text$ssh_note"; else log "idle 0/$MINUTES min$1$input_note$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi

esac

}

if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 1 ]; then suspend_now "suspending: $rdp_idle_text$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi

if [ "$elapsed" -ge "$MINUTES" ]; then suspend_now "suspending: idle $elapsed min$input_note$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi

#!/bin/sh
# managed by machine install idle-suspend, version 8
# Suspends this box once it has been idle for MINUTES minutes. Run as root by machine-idle-suspend.timer every 30 s, 1 min or 2 min (the smallest of the three minutes below decides, decision 113).
# Generated by "machine install idle-suspend --minutes <n>": do not edit (the next install rewrites it). See idle-suspend.md.
# EVERY input that cannot be read means "not idle": this script never suspends on an error.
ROOT=''
MINUTES=5
RDP_MINUTES=5
SSH_MINUTES=5
WAKE_GRACE_MINUTES=1
GAP_SECONDS=300
DATE='/usr/bin/date'
SS='/usr/bin/ss'
INHIBIT='/usr/bin/systemd-inhibit'
LOGGER='/usr/bin/logger'
SYSTEMCTL='/usr/bin/systemctl'
LOGINCTL='/usr/bin/loginctl'
RUNUSER='/usr/sbin/runuser'
XPRINTIDLE='/usr/bin/xprintidle'
AUDIT_LOG='/home/alice/.config/machine/audit.log'
PORT_FILE='/home/alice/.config/machine/daemon.port.json'
KEEP_AWAKE_USER='/home/alice/.config/machine/keep-awake'
KEEP_AWAKE_RUN='/run/machine-keep-awake'
STATE_DIR='/run/machine-idle-suspend'
STATE_FILE='/run/machine-idle-suspend/since'
RESUME_FILE='/run/machine-idle-suspend/resume'
RESUME_COUNTER='/sys/power/suspend_stats/success'

# resume_note ends every line of the pass once the resume detection is off (decision 113): the cause is never silent.
resume_note=''
log() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1$resume_note"
  "$ROOT$LOGGER" -t machine-idle-suspend -- "$1$resume_note" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
clear_state() { rm -f -- "$ROOT$STATE_FILE"; }
not_idle() { clear_state; log "not idle: $1"; exit 0; }

now=$("$ROOT$DATE" +%s 2>/dev/null)
case $now in ''|*[!0-9]*) log "cannot read the clock (date failed): not suspending"; exit 1 ;; esac

# (r) Decision 113: resume detection, at EVERY pass before any check. The kernel counter of the successful suspends is compared with the record of the previous pass
# (<counter> <epoch it was first seen>, or "unreadable <epoch>"). A greater, lower or unrecorded counter is a resume NOW: the wake grace starts at this pass (at most one cadence
# after the real wake). An unreadable counter is a resume ONCE: the record "unreadable" keeps the start of that grace, so it never blocks for ever, and the cause ends every line.
resume_cause=''
resume_counter=$(cat -- "$ROOT$RESUME_COUNTER" 2>/dev/null) || resume_cause="cannot read /sys/power/suspend_stats/success (missing or unreadable)"
if [ -z "$resume_cause" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$resume_counter" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})$' || resume_cause="/sys/power/suspend_stats/success does not hold a whole number"
fi
stored_kind=absent
stored_counter=''
stored_seen=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE" ]; then
  stored_kind=bad
  if stored_text=$(cat -- "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE" 2>/dev/null); then
    if printf '%s\n' "$stored_text" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,12} [0-9]{1,12}$'; then
      read -r stored_counter stored_seen <<EOF
$stored_text
EOF
      stored_kind=counter
    elif printf '%s\n' "$stored_text" | grep -Eq '^unreadable [0-9]{1,12}$'; then
      read -r stored_word stored_seen <<EOF
$stored_text
EOF
      stored_kind=unreadable
    fi
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$resume_cause" ]; then
  resume_note=" (resume detection off: $resume_cause)"
  if [ "$stored_kind" = unreadable ]; then resume_seen=$stored_seen; else resume_seen=$now; fi
  resume_record=unreadable
else
  case $stored_kind in
    counter) if [ "$resume_counter" -eq "$stored_counter" ]; then resume_seen=$stored_seen; else resume_seen=$now; fi ;;
    unreadable) resume_seen=$stored_seen ;;
    *) resume_seen=$now ;;
  esac
  resume_record=$resume_counter
fi
if [ "$resume_seen" -gt "$now" ]; then resume_seen=$now; fi
mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot create $STATE_DIR: not suspending"; exit 1; }
{ printf '%s %s\n' "$resume_record" "$resume_seen" > "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE"; } 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot write $RESUME_FILE: not suspending"; exit 1; }
grace_left=$((resume_seen + WAKE_GRACE_MINUTES * 60 - now))

# (a) keep-awake files: any content keeps the box awake; "until <epoch>" (or "keep awake until <epoch>") only until then.
check_keep_awake() {
  [ -e "$ROOT$1" ] || return 0
  content=$(cat -- "$ROOT$1" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the keep-awake files"
  until_epoch=$(printf '%s\n' "$content" | sed -n -E '1{s/^[[:space:]]+//;s/[[:space:]]+$//;s/^(keep awake )?until ([0-9]{1,12})$/\2/p;}')
  if [ -n "$until_epoch" ] && [ "$until_epoch" -le "$now" ]; then return 0; fi
  not_idle "keep-awake requested"
}
check_keep_awake "$KEEP_AWAKE_RUN"
check_keep_awake "$KEEP_AWAKE_USER"

# (b) established connections to RDP, ssh and the machine peer port (read from the daemon port file).
peer_port=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$PORT_FILE" ]; then
  port_json=$(cat -- "$ROOT$PORT_FILE" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
  peer_port=$(printf '%s\n' "$port_json" | sed -n -E 's/.*"peerPort"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*([0-9]{1,5}).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$peer_port" ] || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
fi
sockets=$("$ROOT$SS" -Htn state established 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
rdp=0
ssh=0
peer=0
while read -r c1 c2 c3 c4 rest; do
  case $c1 in ESTAB|estab) local_addr=$c4 ;; *) local_addr=$c3 ;; esac
  port=$(printf '%s\n' "$local_addr" | sed 's/.*://')
  [ "$port" = 3389 ] && rdp=$((rdp + 1))
  [ "$port" = 22 ] && ssh=$((ssh + 1))
  if [ -n "$peer_port" ] && [ "$port" = "$peer_port" ]; then peer=$((peer + 1)); fi
done <<EOF
$sockets
EOF
# (b1) Decision 111: EVERY ssh connection is tested. It is read here, before any later check can exit, so the samples of the notty connections are kept at every run
# (they are NOT cleared with the timer state). ss -Htinp prints, per connection, a line with the Process column (every pid of the login: the [priv] parent AND the
# user process) and, tab-indented, the counters. The title of each pid (/proc/<pid>/cmdline, set by sshd) ending in @pts/<n> is a terminal login: activity while the input
# idle time of its tty (atime of /dev/pts/<n>, what w and logind read) is below SSH_MINUTES, its traffic is ignored. A title ending in @notty (scp, rsync, ssh host cmd,
# herdr) is activity when the average rate of its TCP connection since the previous run (bytes_acked + bytes_received, samples file) is at least THRESHOLD B/s, or unknown
# (first sight, sample older than 5 min, counter went down, counters unreadable). Anything unreadable (no login title for the connection, a tty that is not pts/<n>,
# no stat, an atime in the future, no ss, no samples file to write) is activity, with the cause. /dev/pts is never listed (a stale pts has no sshd process).
THRESHOLD=2048
SSH_SAMPLES='/run/machine-idle-suspend/ssh-samples'
ssh_fail=''
ssh_pts_secs=''
ssh_pts_tty=''
ssh_block=''
ssh_quiet_note=''
ssh_new_samples=''
ssh_old=''
ssh_cur_open=0
ssh_cur_local=''
ssh_cur_peer=''
ssh_cur_proc=''
ssh_cur_info=''
ssh_fail_set() { [ -n "$ssh_fail" ] || ssh_fail="$1"; }
ssh_unknown() { [ -n "$ssh_block" ] || ssh_block="ssh connection $c_peer rate unknown ($1)"; }
ssh_notty() {
  c_acked=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_info" | grep -Eo '(^|[[:space:]])bytes_acked:[^[:space:]]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*://')
  c_recv=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_info" | grep -Eo '(^|[[:space:]])bytes_received:[^[:space:]]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*://')
  printf '%s\n' "$c_acked" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "bytes_acked or bytes_received missing or not a number in ss -tin"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$c_recv" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "bytes_acked or bytes_received missing or not a number in ss -tin"; return 0; }
  c_total=$((c_acked + c_recv))
  ssh_new_samples="$ssh_new_samples$c_local $c_peer $now $c_total
"
  prev_epoch=''
  prev_total=''
  while read -r o_local o_peer o_epoch o_total o_rest; do
    if [ "$o_local" = "$c_local" ] && [ "$o_peer" = "$c_peer" ]; then prev_epoch=$o_epoch; prev_total=$o_total; break; fi
  done <<EOF
$ssh_old
EOF
  [ -n "$prev_epoch" ] || { ssh_unknown "first check of this connection (no previous sample)"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$prev_epoch" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})$' && printf '%s\n' "$prev_total" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "previous sample unreadable"; return 0; }
  c_dt=$((now - prev_epoch))
  [ "$c_dt" -gt 0 ] || { ssh_unknown "the clock did not advance since the previous sample"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_dt" -le 300 ] || { ssh_unknown "previous sample older than 300 s"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_total" -ge "$prev_total" ] || { ssh_unknown "byte counter went down (a new connection on the same address)"; return 0; }
  c_rate=$(( (c_total - prev_total) / c_dt ))
  if [ "$c_rate" -ge "$THRESHOLD" ]; then
    [ -n "$ssh_block" ] || ssh_block="ssh connection $c_peer active ($c_rate B/s, needs $THRESHOLD)"
  else
    ssh_quiet_note="$ssh_quiet_note (ssh connection $c_peer quiet: $c_rate B/s, under $THRESHOLD)"
  fi
}
ssh_conn() {
  c_local=$1
  c_peer=$2
  c_proc=$3
  c_info=$4
  c_kind=''
  c_login_pid=''
  for c_pid in $(printf '%s\n' "$c_proc" | grep -Eo 'pid=[0-9]{1,8}' | sed 's/^pid=//'); do
    c_file="$ROOT/proc/$c_pid/cmdline"
    [ -e "$c_file" ] || continue
    c_title=$(tr -d '\000' <"$c_file" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    c_tty=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_title" | sed -n -E 's/^sshd(-session)?: [^ ]+@(.*)$/\2/p')
    [ -n "$c_tty" ] || continue
    c_kind=$c_tty
    c_login_pid=$c_pid
    break
  done
  if [ -z "$c_kind" ]; then ssh_fail_set "no sshd login process (title sshd-session: <user>@<tty>) found for the ssh connection $c_peer"; return 0; fi
  if [ "$c_kind" = notty ]; then ssh_notty; return 0; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$c_kind" | grep -Eq '^pts/[0-9]{1,6}$' || { ssh_fail_set "an sshd login process has an unexpected tty in its title ($c_login_pid)"; return 0; }
  c_atime=$(stat -c %X -- "$ROOT/dev/$c_kind" 2>/dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot read the idle time of $c_kind (stat /dev/$c_kind failed)"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$c_atime" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,12}$' || { ssh_fail_set "stat printed no number for /dev/$c_kind"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_atime" -le "$now" ] || { ssh_fail_set "the last input of $c_kind is in the future (clock or tty error)"; return 0; }
  c_secs=$((now - c_atime))
  if [ -z "$ssh_pts_tty" ] || [ "$c_secs" -lt "$ssh_pts_secs" ]; then ssh_pts_secs=$c_secs; ssh_pts_tty=$c_kind; fi
}
ssh_flush() {
  [ "$ssh_cur_open" -eq 1 ] || return 0
  ssh_cur_open=0
  printf '%s\n' "$ssh_cur_local" | grep -Eqx '[][0-9A-Za-z:.%_-]+' && printf '%s\n' "$ssh_cur_peer" | grep -Eqx '[][0-9A-Za-z:.%_-]+' || { ssh_fail_set "cannot parse an address of the ssh connections printed by ss"; return 0; }
  ssh_conn "$ssh_cur_local" "$ssh_cur_peer" "$ssh_cur_proc" "$ssh_cur_info"
}
read_ssh() {
  ssh_listing=$("$ROOT$SS" -Htinp state established '( sport = :22 )' 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot list the ssh connections ($SS -tinp failed)"; return 0; }
  if [ -e "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES" ]; then ssh_old=$(cat -- "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES" 2>/dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot read $SSH_SAMPLES"; ssh_old=''; }; fi
  while IFS= read -r ssh_line; do
    ssh_trim=$(printf '%s\n' "$ssh_line" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
    case $ssh_trim in
      '') continue ;;
      ESTAB*|estab*|[0-9]*) ;;
      *) ssh_cur_info="$ssh_cur_info $ssh_trim"; continue ;;
    esac
    ssh_flush
    read -r c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 <<EOT
$ssh_trim
EOT
    case $c1 in ESTAB|estab) ssh_cur_local=$c4; ssh_cur_peer=$c5; ssh_cur_proc=$c6 ;; *) ssh_cur_local=$c3; ssh_cur_peer=$c4; ssh_cur_proc=$c5 ;; esac
    ssh_cur_info=''
    ssh_cur_open=1
  done <<EOF
$ssh_listing
EOF
  ssh_flush
  if mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null && { printf '%s' "$ssh_new_samples" > "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES"; } 2>/dev/null; then :; else ssh_fail_set "cannot write $SSH_SAMPLES"; fi
}
# Without an ssh connection the samples are dropped (a vanished connection leaves no entry).
if [ "$ssh" -gt 0 ]; then read_ssh; else rm -f -- "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES"; fi
# (b2) the input idle time (xprintidle, ms), measured per logind SESSION (decision 105): the minimum over the user sessions that have an X display, each read as its user.
# input_kind: num (input_secs), missing (no xprintidle), nosession (no such session), bad (input_cause). ignored_text names the X sockets that no such session uses.
input_kind=num
input_secs=''
input_cause=''
ignored_text=''
input_bad() { input_kind=bad; input_cause="$1"; }
read_input() {
  [ -x "$ROOT$XPRINTIDLE" ] || { input_kind=missing; return 0; }
  [ -x "$ROOT$LOGINCTL" ] || { input_bad "loginctl is not installed ($LOGINCTL)"; return 0; }
  [ -x "$ROOT$RUNUSER" ] || { input_bad "runuser is not installed ($RUNUSER)"; return 0; }
  session_list=$("$ROOT$LOGINCTL" list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "loginctl list-sessions failed"; return 0; }
  min_idle=''
  measured=' '
  while read -r sid rest; do
    [ -n "$sid" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$sid" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}$' || { input_bad "loginctl printed an unexpected session id"; return 0; }
    props=$("$ROOT$LOGINCTL" show-session "$sid" -p Name -p Type -p Display -p Class -p State 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "loginctl show-session $sid failed"; return 0; }
    s_class=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Class=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_state=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^State=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_display=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Display=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_name=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Name=//p' | head -n 1)
    [ "$s_class" = user ] || continue
    case $s_state in active|online) ;; *) continue ;; esac
    [ -n "$s_display" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$s_name" | grep -Eq '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$' || { input_bad "the name of session $sid is not a plain user name"; return 0; }
    printf '%s\n' "$s_display" | grep -Eq '^:[0-9]{1,4}$' || { input_bad "session $sid has an unexpected display"; return 0; }
    num=$(printf '%s\n' "$s_display" | sed 's/^://')
    home=$(sed -n -E 's/^'"$s_name"':[^:]*:[0-9]*:[0-9]*:[^:]*:([^:]*):.*/\1/p' "$ROOT/etc/passwd" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
    printf '%s\n' "$home" | grep -Eq '^(/[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+)+$' || { input_bad "no usable home folder for $s_name in /etc/passwd"; return 0; }
    out=$(DISPLAY=":$num" XAUTHORITY="$home/.Xauthority" "$ROOT$RUNUSER" -u "$s_name" -- "$ROOT$XPRINTIDLE" 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "xprintidle failed on :$num as $s_name"; return 0; }
    printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,15}$' || { input_bad "xprintidle printed no number on :$num"; return 0; }
    secs=$((out / 1000))
    if [ -z "$min_idle" ] || [ "$secs" -lt "$min_idle" ]; then min_idle=$secs; fi
    measured="$measured$num "
  done <<EOF
$session_list
EOF
  [ -n "$min_idle" ] || { input_kind=nosession; return 0; }
  input_secs=$min_idle
  # The X sockets that no measured session uses (the login greeter...) are ignored on purpose, and said.
  ignored_list=''
  ignored_count=0
  for sock in "$ROOT/tmp/.X11-unix"/X*; do
    [ -e "$sock" ] || continue
    num=$(printf '%s\n' "$sock" | sed 's/.*\/X//')
    printf '%s\n' "$num" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,4}$' || continue
    case $measured in *" $num "*) continue ;; esac
    if [ -z "$ignored_list" ]; then ignored_list=":$num"; else ignored_list="$ignored_list, :$num"; fi
    ignored_count=$((ignored_count + 1))
  done
  if [ "$ignored_count" -eq 1 ]; then ignored_text=" (ignored display $ignored_list: no user session)"; fi
  if [ "$ignored_count" -gt 1 ]; then ignored_text=" (ignored displays $ignored_list: no user session)"; fi
}
read_input
# With an RDP connection the input idle time is the clock: activity until it reaches RDP_MINUTES, and no timer on top (decision 103).
rdp_mode=0
if [ "$rdp" -gt 0 ]; then
  rdp_mode=1
  [ "$input_kind" != missing ] || not_idle "rdp connected (xprintidle is not installed: sudo apt install xprintidle)"
  [ "$input_kind" != nosession ] || not_idle "rdp connected but no user session found"
  [ "$input_kind" != bad ] || not_idle "rdp connected (input idle unreadable: $input_cause)"
  if [ "$input_secs" -lt $((RDP_MINUTES * 60)) ]; then not_idle "rdp connected (input $((input_secs / 60)) min ago, needs $RDP_MINUTES)$ignored_text"; fi
fi
# Decision 111 verdict (the connections were read in (b1)): unreadable is activity, then a pts login with recent input, then a notty connection that is busy or whose rate is unknown.
ssh_note=''
if [ "$ssh" -gt 0 ]; then
  [ -z "$ssh_fail" ] || not_idle "ssh connected (cannot read the ssh state: $ssh_fail)"
  if [ -n "$ssh_pts_tty" ]; then
    if [ "$ssh_pts_secs" -lt $((SSH_MINUTES * 60)) ]; then
      not_idle "ssh session $ssh_pts_tty active (input $((ssh_pts_secs / 60)) min ago, needs $SSH_MINUTES)"
    fi
    ssh_note=" (ssh session $ssh_pts_tty idle for $((ssh_pts_secs / 60)) min, needs $SSH_MINUTES)"
  fi
  [ -z "$ssh_block" ] || not_idle "$ssh_block"
  ssh_note="$ssh_note$ssh_quiet_note"
fi
[ "$peer" -eq 0 ] || not_idle "machine peer connected"
# Without an RDP connection: a readable input must be MINUTES old; an unreadable one is said on every timer line.
input_note=''
if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 0 ]; then
  case $input_kind in
    num) if [ "$input_secs" -lt $((MINUTES * 60)) ]; then not_idle "input $((input_secs / 60)) min ago (needs $MINUTES)$ignored_text"; fi ;;
    missing) input_note=' (input idleness not checked: xprintidle is not installed)' ;;
    nosession) input_note=' (input idleness not checked: no user session found)' ;;
    *) input_note=" (input idleness not checked: $input_cause)" ;;
  esac
fi

# (c) the machine audit log: a request accepted, completed or held in the last MINUTES minutes, or a hold still open.
epoch_of() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,9})?Z$' || not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log"
  EPOCH=$("$ROOT$DATE" -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null)
  case $EPOCH in ''|*[!0-9]*) not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log" ;; esac
}
audit_tail=$(tail -n 2000 -- "$ROOT$AUDIT_LOG" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log"
last_ts=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"([^"]*)","event":"(accepted|completed|held)".*$/\1/p' | tail -n 1)
last_activity=''
if [ -n "$last_ts" ]; then
  epoch_of "$last_ts"
  last_activity=$EPOCH
fi
held=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"([^"]*)","event":"held","source":"[^"]*","id":"([^"]+)".*$/\1 \2/p' | tail -n 50)
ended=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"[^"]*","event":"hold-ended","source":"[^"]*","id":"([^"]+)".*$/\1/p')
open_holds=0
if [ -n "$held" ]; then
  while read -r held_ts held_id; do
    epoch_of "$held_ts"
    [ $((now - EPOCH)) -le 7200 ] || continue
    if printf '%s\n' "$ended" | grep -Fxq -- "$held_id"; then continue; fi
    open_holds=$((open_holds + 1))
  done <<EOF
$held
EOF
fi
[ "$open_holds" -eq 0 ] || not_idle "machine request on hold"
if [ -n "$last_activity" ] && [ $((now - last_activity)) -lt $((MINUTES * 60)) ]; then
  not_idle "machine request in the last $MINUTES min"
fi

# (d) the 5-minute load average.
loadavg=$(cat -- "$ROOT/proc/loadavg" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the load average"
read -r l1 l5 l15 rest <<EOF
$loadavg
EOF
printf '%s\n' "$l5" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,5})\.[0-9]{2}$' || not_idle "cannot read the load average"
IFS=. read -r load_int load_frac <<EOF
$l5
EOF
load_frac=$(printf '%s' "$load_frac" | sed 's/^0//')
load=$((load_int * 100 + load_frac))
if [ "$load" -ge 30 ]; then
  not_idle "$(printf 'load %d.%02d (limit 0.30)' $((load / 100)) $((load % 100)))"
fi

# (e) an inhibitor in block mode that covers sleep.
inhibitors=$("$ROOT$INHIBIT" --list --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot list the sleep inhibitors"
blocking=$(printf '%s\n' "$inhibitors" | grep -Ec '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])sleep([^[:alnum:]_-]|$).*[[:space:]]block[[:space:]]*$')
[ "$blocking" = 0 ] || not_idle "sleep inhibitor held (block)"
# Decision 113: no automatic suspend during the wake grace (xprintidle counts the sleep, so every reading says idle right after a wake).
if [ "$grace_left" -gt 0 ]; then not_idle "wake grace ($(( (grace_left + 59) / 60 )) min left)"; fi

# Idle now: the timer. The state file holds "<since> <last check>" in epoch seconds.
mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot create $STATE_DIR: not suspending"; exit 1; }
state=none
state_since=''
state_last=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$STATE_FILE" ]; then
  state=bad
  if state_text=$(cat -- "$ROOT$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null); then
    if printf '%s\n' "$state_text" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,12} [0-9]{1,12}$'; then
      read -r state_since state_last <<EOF
$state_text
EOF
      if [ "$state_since" -le "$state_last" ]; then state=ok; fi
    fi
  fi
fi
write_state() {
  printf '%s %s\n' "$1" "$now" > "$ROOT$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot write $STATE_FILE: not suspending"; exit 1; }
}
rdp_idle_text="rdp connected but no input for $((input_secs / 60)) min (needs $RDP_MINUTES)"
restart() {
  write_state "$now"
  if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 1 ]; then log "idle: $rdp_idle_text, confirming at the next check$1$ignored_text$ssh_note"; else log "idle 0/$MINUTES min$1$input_note$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi
  exit 0
}
case $state in
  none) restart '' ;;
  bad) restart ' (timer restarted: the state file is unreadable)' ;;
esac
if [ "$state_since" -gt "$now" ] || [ "$state_last" -gt "$now" ]; then restart ' (timer restarted: the clock went back)'; fi
if [ $((now - state_last)) -gt $GAP_SECONDS ]; then restart ' (timer restarted: no check for more than 5 min, the box slept or was off)'; fi
suspend_now() {
  clear_state
  log "$1"
  "$ROOT$SYSTEMCTL" --no-block suspend || { log "cannot suspend: systemctl suspend failed"; exit 1; }
  exit 0
}
# RDP mode: the other checks have passed on the previous check too (the state is recent), the input idle time is the clock.
if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 1 ]; then suspend_now "suspending: $rdp_idle_text$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi
elapsed=$(( (now - state_since) / 60 ))
if [ "$elapsed" -ge "$MINUTES" ]; then suspend_now "suspending: idle $elapsed min$input_note$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi
write_state "$state_since"
log "idle $elapsed/$MINUTES min$input_note$ignored_text$ssh_note"

#!/bin/sh
# managed by machine install idle-suspend, version 8
# Suspends this box once it has been idle for MINUTES minutes. Run as root by machine-idle-suspend.timer every 30 s, 1 min or 2 min (the smallest of the three minutes below decides, decision 113).
# Generated by "machine install idle-suspend --minutes <n>": do not edit (the next install rewrites it). See idle-suspend.md.
# EVERY input that cannot be read means "not idle": this script never suspends on an error.
ROOT=''
MINUTES=90
RDP_MINUTES=60
SSH_MINUTES=45
WAKE_GRACE_MINUTES=60
GAP_SECONDS=1200
DATE='/usr/bin/date'
SS='/usr/bin/ss'
INHIBIT='/usr/bin/systemd-inhibit'
LOGGER='/usr/bin/logger'
SYSTEMCTL='/usr/bin/systemctl'
LOGINCTL='/usr/bin/loginctl'
RUNUSER='/usr/sbin/runuser'
XPRINTIDLE='/usr/bin/xprintidle'
AUDIT_LOG='/home/alice/.config/machine/audit.log'
PORT_FILE='/home/alice/.config/machine/daemon.port.json'
KEEP_AWAKE_USER='/home/alice/.config/machine/keep-awake'
KEEP_AWAKE_RUN='/run/machine-keep-awake'
STATE_DIR='/run/machine-idle-suspend'
STATE_FILE='/run/machine-idle-suspend/since'
RESUME_FILE='/run/machine-idle-suspend/resume'
RESUME_COUNTER='/sys/power/suspend_stats/success'

# resume_note ends every line of the pass once the resume detection is off (decision 113): the cause is never silent.
resume_note=''
log() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1$resume_note"
  "$ROOT$LOGGER" -t machine-idle-suspend -- "$1$resume_note" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
clear_state() { rm -f -- "$ROOT$STATE_FILE"; }
not_idle() { clear_state; log "not idle: $1"; exit 0; }

now=$("$ROOT$DATE" +%s 2>/dev/null)
case $now in ''|*[!0-9]*) log "cannot read the clock (date failed): not suspending"; exit 1 ;; esac

# (r) Decision 113: resume detection, at EVERY pass before any check. The kernel counter of the successful suspends is compared with the record of the previous pass
# (<counter> <epoch it was first seen>, or "unreadable <epoch>"). A greater, lower or unrecorded counter is a resume NOW: the wake grace starts at this pass (at most one cadence
# after the real wake). An unreadable counter is a resume ONCE: the record "unreadable" keeps the start of that grace, so it never blocks for ever, and the cause ends every line.
resume_cause=''
resume_counter=$(cat -- "$ROOT$RESUME_COUNTER" 2>/dev/null) || resume_cause="cannot read /sys/power/suspend_stats/success (missing or unreadable)"
if [ -z "$resume_cause" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$resume_counter" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})$' || resume_cause="/sys/power/suspend_stats/success does not hold a whole number"
fi
stored_kind=absent
stored_counter=''
stored_seen=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE" ]; then
  stored_kind=bad
  if stored_text=$(cat -- "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE" 2>/dev/null); then
    if printf '%s\n' "$stored_text" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,12} [0-9]{1,12}$'; then
      read -r stored_counter stored_seen <<EOF
$stored_text
EOF
      stored_kind=counter
    elif printf '%s\n' "$stored_text" | grep -Eq '^unreadable [0-9]{1,12}$'; then
      read -r stored_word stored_seen <<EOF
$stored_text
EOF
      stored_kind=unreadable
    fi
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$resume_cause" ]; then
  resume_note=" (resume detection off: $resume_cause)"
  if [ "$stored_kind" = unreadable ]; then resume_seen=$stored_seen; else resume_seen=$now; fi
  resume_record=unreadable
else
  case $stored_kind in
    counter) if [ "$resume_counter" -eq "$stored_counter" ]; then resume_seen=$stored_seen; else resume_seen=$now; fi ;;
    unreadable) resume_seen=$stored_seen ;;
    *) resume_seen=$now ;;
  esac
  resume_record=$resume_counter
fi
if [ "$resume_seen" -gt "$now" ]; then resume_seen=$now; fi
mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot create $STATE_DIR: not suspending"; exit 1; }
{ printf '%s %s\n' "$resume_record" "$resume_seen" > "$ROOT$RESUME_FILE"; } 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot write $RESUME_FILE: not suspending"; exit 1; }
grace_left=$((resume_seen + WAKE_GRACE_MINUTES * 60 - now))

# (a) keep-awake files: any content keeps the box awake; "until <epoch>" (or "keep awake until <epoch>") only until then.
check_keep_awake() {
  [ -e "$ROOT$1" ] || return 0
  content=$(cat -- "$ROOT$1" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the keep-awake files"
  until_epoch=$(printf '%s\n' "$content" | sed -n -E '1{s/^[[:space:]]+//;s/[[:space:]]+$//;s/^(keep awake )?until ([0-9]{1,12})$/\2/p;}')
  if [ -n "$until_epoch" ] && [ "$until_epoch" -le "$now" ]; then return 0; fi
  not_idle "keep-awake requested"
}
check_keep_awake "$KEEP_AWAKE_RUN"
check_keep_awake "$KEEP_AWAKE_USER"

# (b) established connections to RDP, ssh and the machine peer port (read from the daemon port file).
peer_port=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$PORT_FILE" ]; then
  port_json=$(cat -- "$ROOT$PORT_FILE" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
  peer_port=$(printf '%s\n' "$port_json" | sed -n -E 's/.*"peerPort"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*([0-9]{1,5}).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$peer_port" ] || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
fi
sockets=$("$ROOT$SS" -Htn state established 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the connections (ss or the daemon port file)"
rdp=0
ssh=0
peer=0
while read -r c1 c2 c3 c4 rest; do
  case $c1 in ESTAB|estab) local_addr=$c4 ;; *) local_addr=$c3 ;; esac
  port=$(printf '%s\n' "$local_addr" | sed 's/.*://')
  [ "$port" = 3389 ] && rdp=$((rdp + 1))
  [ "$port" = 22 ] && ssh=$((ssh + 1))
  if [ -n "$peer_port" ] && [ "$port" = "$peer_port" ]; then peer=$((peer + 1)); fi
done <<EOF
$sockets
EOF
# (b1) Decision 111: EVERY ssh connection is tested. It is read here, before any later check can exit, so the samples of the notty connections are kept at every run
# (they are NOT cleared with the timer state). ss -Htinp prints, per connection, a line with the Process column (every pid of the login: the [priv] parent AND the
# user process) and, tab-indented, the counters. The title of each pid (/proc/<pid>/cmdline, set by sshd) ending in @pts/<n> is a terminal login: activity while the input
# idle time of its tty (atime of /dev/pts/<n>, what w and logind read) is below SSH_MINUTES, its traffic is ignored. A title ending in @notty (scp, rsync, ssh host cmd,
# herdr) is activity when the average rate of its TCP connection since the previous run (bytes_acked + bytes_received, samples file) is at least THRESHOLD B/s, or unknown
# (first sight, sample older than 5 min, counter went down, counters unreadable). Anything unreadable (no login title for the connection, a tty that is not pts/<n>,
# no stat, an atime in the future, no ss, no samples file to write) is activity, with the cause. /dev/pts is never listed (a stale pts has no sshd process).
THRESHOLD=2048
SSH_SAMPLES='/run/machine-idle-suspend/ssh-samples'
ssh_fail=''
ssh_pts_secs=''
ssh_pts_tty=''
ssh_block=''
ssh_quiet_note=''
ssh_new_samples=''
ssh_old=''
ssh_cur_open=0
ssh_cur_local=''
ssh_cur_peer=''
ssh_cur_proc=''
ssh_cur_info=''
ssh_fail_set() { [ -n "$ssh_fail" ] || ssh_fail="$1"; }
ssh_unknown() { [ -n "$ssh_block" ] || ssh_block="ssh connection $c_peer rate unknown ($1)"; }
ssh_notty() {
  c_acked=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_info" | grep -Eo '(^|[[:space:]])bytes_acked:[^[:space:]]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*://')
  c_recv=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_info" | grep -Eo '(^|[[:space:]])bytes_received:[^[:space:]]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*://')
  printf '%s\n' "$c_acked" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "bytes_acked or bytes_received missing or not a number in ss -tin"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$c_recv" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "bytes_acked or bytes_received missing or not a number in ss -tin"; return 0; }
  c_total=$((c_acked + c_recv))
  ssh_new_samples="$ssh_new_samples$c_local $c_peer $now $c_total
"
  prev_epoch=''
  prev_total=''
  while read -r o_local o_peer o_epoch o_total o_rest; do
    if [ "$o_local" = "$c_local" ] && [ "$o_peer" = "$c_peer" ]; then prev_epoch=$o_epoch; prev_total=$o_total; break; fi
  done <<EOF
$ssh_old
EOF
  [ -n "$prev_epoch" ] || { ssh_unknown "first check of this connection (no previous sample)"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$prev_epoch" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})$' && printf '%s\n' "$prev_total" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})$' || { ssh_unknown "previous sample unreadable"; return 0; }
  c_dt=$((now - prev_epoch))
  [ "$c_dt" -gt 0 ] || { ssh_unknown "the clock did not advance since the previous sample"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_dt" -le 300 ] || { ssh_unknown "previous sample older than 300 s"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_total" -ge "$prev_total" ] || { ssh_unknown "byte counter went down (a new connection on the same address)"; return 0; }
  c_rate=$(( (c_total - prev_total) / c_dt ))
  if [ "$c_rate" -ge "$THRESHOLD" ]; then
    [ -n "$ssh_block" ] || ssh_block="ssh connection $c_peer active ($c_rate B/s, needs $THRESHOLD)"
  else
    ssh_quiet_note="$ssh_quiet_note (ssh connection $c_peer quiet: $c_rate B/s, under $THRESHOLD)"
  fi
}
ssh_conn() {
  c_local=$1
  c_peer=$2
  c_proc=$3
  c_info=$4
  c_kind=''
  c_login_pid=''
  for c_pid in $(printf '%s\n' "$c_proc" | grep -Eo 'pid=[0-9]{1,8}' | sed 's/^pid=//'); do
    c_file="$ROOT/proc/$c_pid/cmdline"
    [ -e "$c_file" ] || continue
    c_title=$(tr -d '\000' <"$c_file" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    c_tty=$(printf '%s\n' "$c_title" | sed -n -E 's/^sshd(-session)?: [^ ]+@(.*)$/\2/p')
    [ -n "$c_tty" ] || continue
    c_kind=$c_tty
    c_login_pid=$c_pid
    break
  done
  if [ -z "$c_kind" ]; then ssh_fail_set "no sshd login process (title sshd-session: <user>@<tty>) found for the ssh connection $c_peer"; return 0; fi
  if [ "$c_kind" = notty ]; then ssh_notty; return 0; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$c_kind" | grep -Eq '^pts/[0-9]{1,6}$' || { ssh_fail_set "an sshd login process has an unexpected tty in its title ($c_login_pid)"; return 0; }
  c_atime=$(stat -c %X -- "$ROOT/dev/$c_kind" 2>/dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot read the idle time of $c_kind (stat /dev/$c_kind failed)"; return 0; }
  printf '%s\n' "$c_atime" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,12}$' || { ssh_fail_set "stat printed no number for /dev/$c_kind"; return 0; }
  [ "$c_atime" -le "$now" ] || { ssh_fail_set "the last input of $c_kind is in the future (clock or tty error)"; return 0; }
  c_secs=$((now - c_atime))
  if [ -z "$ssh_pts_tty" ] || [ "$c_secs" -lt "$ssh_pts_secs" ]; then ssh_pts_secs=$c_secs; ssh_pts_tty=$c_kind; fi
}
ssh_flush() {
  [ "$ssh_cur_open" -eq 1 ] || return 0
  ssh_cur_open=0
  printf '%s\n' "$ssh_cur_local" | grep -Eqx '[][0-9A-Za-z:.%_-]+' && printf '%s\n' "$ssh_cur_peer" | grep -Eqx '[][0-9A-Za-z:.%_-]+' || { ssh_fail_set "cannot parse an address of the ssh connections printed by ss"; return 0; }
  ssh_conn "$ssh_cur_local" "$ssh_cur_peer" "$ssh_cur_proc" "$ssh_cur_info"
}
read_ssh() {
  ssh_listing=$("$ROOT$SS" -Htinp state established '( sport = :22 )' 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot list the ssh connections ($SS -tinp failed)"; return 0; }
  if [ -e "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES" ]; then ssh_old=$(cat -- "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES" 2>/dev/null) || { ssh_fail_set "cannot read $SSH_SAMPLES"; ssh_old=''; }; fi
  while IFS= read -r ssh_line; do
    ssh_trim=$(printf '%s\n' "$ssh_line" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
    case $ssh_trim in
      '') continue ;;
      ESTAB*|estab*|[0-9]*) ;;
      *) ssh_cur_info="$ssh_cur_info $ssh_trim"; continue ;;
    esac
    ssh_flush
    read -r c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 <<EOT
$ssh_trim
EOT
    case $c1 in ESTAB|estab) ssh_cur_local=$c4; ssh_cur_peer=$c5; ssh_cur_proc=$c6 ;; *) ssh_cur_local=$c3; ssh_cur_peer=$c4; ssh_cur_proc=$c5 ;; esac
    ssh_cur_info=''
    ssh_cur_open=1
  done <<EOF
$ssh_listing
EOF
  ssh_flush
  if mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null && { printf '%s' "$ssh_new_samples" > "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES"; } 2>/dev/null; then :; else ssh_fail_set "cannot write $SSH_SAMPLES"; fi
}
# Without an ssh connection the samples are dropped (a vanished connection leaves no entry).
if [ "$ssh" -gt 0 ]; then read_ssh; else rm -f -- "$ROOT$SSH_SAMPLES"; fi
# (b2) the input idle time (xprintidle, ms), measured per logind SESSION (decision 105): the minimum over the user sessions that have an X display, each read as its user.
# input_kind: num (input_secs), missing (no xprintidle), nosession (no such session), bad (input_cause). ignored_text names the X sockets that no such session uses.
input_kind=num
input_secs=''
input_cause=''
ignored_text=''
input_bad() { input_kind=bad; input_cause="$1"; }
read_input() {
  [ -x "$ROOT$XPRINTIDLE" ] || { input_kind=missing; return 0; }
  [ -x "$ROOT$LOGINCTL" ] || { input_bad "loginctl is not installed ($LOGINCTL)"; return 0; }
  [ -x "$ROOT$RUNUSER" ] || { input_bad "runuser is not installed ($RUNUSER)"; return 0; }
  session_list=$("$ROOT$LOGINCTL" list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "loginctl list-sessions failed"; return 0; }
  min_idle=''
  measured=' '
  while read -r sid rest; do
    [ -n "$sid" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$sid" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}$' || { input_bad "loginctl printed an unexpected session id"; return 0; }
    props=$("$ROOT$LOGINCTL" show-session "$sid" -p Name -p Type -p Display -p Class -p State 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "loginctl show-session $sid failed"; return 0; }
    s_class=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Class=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_state=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^State=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_display=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Display=//p' | head -n 1)
    s_name=$(printf '%s\n' "$props" | sed -n 's/^Name=//p' | head -n 1)
    [ "$s_class" = user ] || continue
    case $s_state in active|online) ;; *) continue ;; esac
    [ -n "$s_display" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$s_name" | grep -Eq '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$' || { input_bad "the name of session $sid is not a plain user name"; return 0; }
    printf '%s\n' "$s_display" | grep -Eq '^:[0-9]{1,4}$' || { input_bad "session $sid has an unexpected display"; return 0; }
    num=$(printf '%s\n' "$s_display" | sed 's/^://')
    home=$(sed -n -E 's/^'"$s_name"':[^:]*:[0-9]*:[0-9]*:[^:]*:([^:]*):.*/\1/p' "$ROOT/etc/passwd" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
    printf '%s\n' "$home" | grep -Eq '^(/[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+)+$' || { input_bad "no usable home folder for $s_name in /etc/passwd"; return 0; }
    out=$(DISPLAY=":$num" XAUTHORITY="$home/.Xauthority" "$ROOT$RUNUSER" -u "$s_name" -- "$ROOT$XPRINTIDLE" 2>/dev/null </dev/null) || { input_bad "xprintidle failed on :$num as $s_name"; return 0; }
    printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,15}$' || { input_bad "xprintidle printed no number on :$num"; return 0; }
    secs=$((out / 1000))
    if [ -z "$min_idle" ] || [ "$secs" -lt "$min_idle" ]; then min_idle=$secs; fi
    measured="$measured$num "
  done <<EOF
$session_list
EOF
  [ -n "$min_idle" ] || { input_kind=nosession; return 0; }
  input_secs=$min_idle
  # The X sockets that no measured session uses (the login greeter...) are ignored on purpose, and said.
  ignored_list=''
  ignored_count=0
  for sock in "$ROOT/tmp/.X11-unix"/X*; do
    [ -e "$sock" ] || continue
    num=$(printf '%s\n' "$sock" | sed 's/.*\/X//')
    printf '%s\n' "$num" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,4}$' || continue
    case $measured in *" $num "*) continue ;; esac
    if [ -z "$ignored_list" ]; then ignored_list=":$num"; else ignored_list="$ignored_list, :$num"; fi
    ignored_count=$((ignored_count + 1))
  done
  if [ "$ignored_count" -eq 1 ]; then ignored_text=" (ignored display $ignored_list: no user session)"; fi
  if [ "$ignored_count" -gt 1 ]; then ignored_text=" (ignored displays $ignored_list: no user session)"; fi
}
read_input
# With an RDP connection the input idle time is the clock: activity until it reaches RDP_MINUTES, and no timer on top (decision 103).
rdp_mode=0
if [ "$rdp" -gt 0 ]; then
  rdp_mode=1
  [ "$input_kind" != missing ] || not_idle "rdp connected (xprintidle is not installed: sudo apt install xprintidle)"
  [ "$input_kind" != nosession ] || not_idle "rdp connected but no user session found"
  [ "$input_kind" != bad ] || not_idle "rdp connected (input idle unreadable: $input_cause)"
  if [ "$input_secs" -lt $((RDP_MINUTES * 60)) ]; then not_idle "rdp connected (input $((input_secs / 60)) min ago, needs $RDP_MINUTES)$ignored_text"; fi
fi
# Decision 111 verdict (the connections were read in (b1)): unreadable is activity, then a pts login with recent input, then a notty connection that is busy or whose rate is unknown.
ssh_note=''
if [ "$ssh" -gt 0 ]; then
  [ -z "$ssh_fail" ] || not_idle "ssh connected (cannot read the ssh state: $ssh_fail)"
  if [ -n "$ssh_pts_tty" ]; then
    if [ "$ssh_pts_secs" -lt $((SSH_MINUTES * 60)) ]; then
      not_idle "ssh session $ssh_pts_tty active (input $((ssh_pts_secs / 60)) min ago, needs $SSH_MINUTES)"
    fi
    ssh_note=" (ssh session $ssh_pts_tty idle for $((ssh_pts_secs / 60)) min, needs $SSH_MINUTES)"
  fi
  [ -z "$ssh_block" ] || not_idle "$ssh_block"
  ssh_note="$ssh_note$ssh_quiet_note"
fi
[ "$peer" -eq 0 ] || not_idle "machine peer connected"
# Without an RDP connection: a readable input must be MINUTES old; an unreadable one is said on every timer line.
input_note=''
if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 0 ]; then
  case $input_kind in
    num) if [ "$input_secs" -lt $((MINUTES * 60)) ]; then not_idle "input $((input_secs / 60)) min ago (needs $MINUTES)$ignored_text"; fi ;;
    missing) input_note=' (input idleness not checked: xprintidle is not installed)' ;;
    nosession) input_note=' (input idleness not checked: no user session found)' ;;
    *) input_note=" (input idleness not checked: $input_cause)" ;;
  esac
fi

# (c) the machine audit log: a request accepted, completed or held in the last MINUTES minutes, or a hold still open.
epoch_of() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,9})?Z$' || not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log"
  EPOCH=$("$ROOT$DATE" -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null)
  case $EPOCH in ''|*[!0-9]*) not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log" ;; esac
}
audit_tail=$(tail -n 2000 -- "$ROOT$AUDIT_LOG" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the machine audit log"
last_ts=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"([^"]*)","event":"(accepted|completed|held)".*$/\1/p' | tail -n 1)
last_activity=''
if [ -n "$last_ts" ]; then
  epoch_of "$last_ts"
  last_activity=$EPOCH
fi
held=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"([^"]*)","event":"held","source":"[^"]*","id":"([^"]+)".*$/\1 \2/p' | tail -n 50)
ended=$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_tail" | sed -n -E 's/^\{"seq":[0-9]+,"prev":"[0-9a-f]+","entry":\{"ts":"[^"]*","event":"hold-ended","source":"[^"]*","id":"([^"]+)".*$/\1/p')
open_holds=0
if [ -n "$held" ]; then
  while read -r held_ts held_id; do
    epoch_of "$held_ts"
    [ $((now - EPOCH)) -le 7200 ] || continue
    if printf '%s\n' "$ended" | grep -Fxq -- "$held_id"; then continue; fi
    open_holds=$((open_holds + 1))
  done <<EOF
$held
EOF
fi
[ "$open_holds" -eq 0 ] || not_idle "machine request on hold"
if [ -n "$last_activity" ] && [ $((now - last_activity)) -lt $((MINUTES * 60)) ]; then
  not_idle "machine request in the last $MINUTES min"
fi

# (d) the 5-minute load average.
loadavg=$(cat -- "$ROOT/proc/loadavg" 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot read the load average"
read -r l1 l5 l15 rest <<EOF
$loadavg
EOF
printf '%s\n' "$l5" | grep -Eq '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,5})\.[0-9]{2}$' || not_idle "cannot read the load average"
IFS=. read -r load_int load_frac <<EOF
$l5
EOF
load_frac=$(printf '%s' "$load_frac" | sed 's/^0//')
load=$((load_int * 100 + load_frac))
if [ "$load" -ge 30 ]; then
  not_idle "$(printf 'load %d.%02d (limit 0.30)' $((load / 100)) $((load % 100)))"
fi

# (e) an inhibitor in block mode that covers sleep.
inhibitors=$("$ROOT$INHIBIT" --list --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null) || not_idle "cannot list the sleep inhibitors"
blocking=$(printf '%s\n' "$inhibitors" | grep -Ec '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])sleep([^[:alnum:]_-]|$).*[[:space:]]block[[:space:]]*$')
[ "$blocking" = 0 ] || not_idle "sleep inhibitor held (block)"
# Decision 113: no automatic suspend during the wake grace (xprintidle counts the sleep, so every reading says idle right after a wake).
if [ "$grace_left" -gt 0 ]; then not_idle "wake grace ($(( (grace_left + 59) / 60 )) min left)"; fi

# Idle now: the timer. The state file holds "<since> <last check>" in epoch seconds.
mkdir -p -- "$ROOT$STATE_DIR" 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot create $STATE_DIR: not suspending"; exit 1; }
state=none
state_since=''
state_last=''
if [ -e "$ROOT$STATE_FILE" ]; then
  state=bad
  if state_text=$(cat -- "$ROOT$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null); then
    if printf '%s\n' "$state_text" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,12} [0-9]{1,12}$'; then
      read -r state_since state_last <<EOF
$state_text
EOF
      if [ "$state_since" -le "$state_last" ]; then state=ok; fi
    fi
  fi
fi
write_state() {
  printf '%s %s\n' "$1" "$now" > "$ROOT$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || { log "cannot write $STATE_FILE: not suspending"; exit 1; }
}
rdp_idle_text="rdp connected but no input for $((input_secs / 60)) min (needs $RDP_MINUTES)"
restart() {
  write_state "$now"
  if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 1 ]; then log "idle: $rdp_idle_text, confirming at the next check$1$ignored_text$ssh_note"; else log "idle 0/$MINUTES min$1$input_note$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi
  exit 0
}
case $state in
  none) restart '' ;;
  bad) restart ' (timer restarted: the state file is unreadable)' ;;
esac
if [ "$state_since" -gt "$now" ] || [ "$state_last" -gt "$now" ]; then restart ' (timer restarted: the clock went back)'; fi
if [ $((now - state_last)) -gt $GAP_SECONDS ]; then restart ' (timer restarted: no check for more than 20 min, the box slept or was off)'; fi
suspend_now() {
  clear_state
  log "$1"
  "$ROOT$SYSTEMCTL" --no-block suspend || { log "cannot suspend: systemctl suspend failed"; exit 1; }
  exit 0
}
# RDP mode: the other checks have passed on the previous check too (the state is recent), the input idle time is the clock.
if [ "$rdp_mode" -eq 1 ]; then suspend_now "suspending: $rdp_idle_text$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi
elapsed=$(( (now - state_since) / 60 ))
if [ "$elapsed" -ge "$MINUTES" ]; then suspend_now "suspending: idle $elapsed min$input_note$ignored_text$ssh_note"; fi
write_state "$state_since"
log "idle $elapsed/$MINUTES min$input_note$ignored_text$ssh_note"
